gameplayPillars.title: Board-game competition
gameplayPillars.description: Roll character-specific Dice Blocks, move around boards, buy Stars and use items strategically.

gameplayPillars.title: 80 Joy-Con minigames
gameplayPillars.description: Free-for-all, 2-vs-2 and 1-vs-3 games use buttons, motion and HD Rumble.

gameplayPillars.title: Mode variety
gameplayPillars.description: Partner Party, River Survival, Sound Stage, Challenge Road and Toad's Rec Room alter the usual formula.

worldSummary: Mario and friends gather across colorful digital game boards and themed minigame arenas. Unlike story-heavy Mario titles, progression centers on Party Points, Challenge Road and unlocking characters, boards and activities.

storyChapters.title: Start the party
storyChapters.body: Choose characters and enter the central plaza of available modes.

storyChapters.title: Challenge Road
storyChapters.body: A solo route strings together the game's minigames as a progression challenge.

storyChapters.title: Party mastery
storyChapters.body: Unlock characters and content while mastering boards, minigames and cooperative modes.

perfNotes: Performance analysis reports 1080p docked and 720p portable/tabletop rendering at a highly stable 60 fps. The software's control design is centered on detached Joy-Con use and does not support ordinary handheld play in the same way as most Switch titles.

faq.q: Can it be played in handheld mode?
faq.a: The game is designed around detached Joy-Con controllers and is primarily intended for TV/tabletop configurations rather than normal attached-Joy-Con handheld play.
Yes. A free update expanded online support to board modes and most minigames.

verdictSummary: A lively party package with clever Joy-Con ideas and strong local multiplayer, though its limited board selection and control requirements make it less flexible than later entries.
verdictCons: Strong dependence on Joy-Con motion controls
